# TNT Domestics

> Luxury house cleaning, estate housekeeping, and commercial, government, post-construction, move-in/move-out and aircraft cleaning in Texas, California and Hawaii.

Based in San Antonio, with customized written care plans, background-checked, NDA-bound professionals and a direct point of contact. Insured and OSHA Compliant.

Phone: 830-500-5791. Email: management@tntdomestics.com. UEI: Z11EBUHZY3U5. NAICS: 561720 (Janitorial Services) and 562119 (Other Waste Collection). Certifications: MBE, WBE, SBE, HUB and AABE. SAM registered.
